correctness.rationale: For x>=0,s>0,t>0 invertibility of the 2-state coherence matrix is immediate from p=1+t+s²−x² and q=x(2+t), whose squared modulus is positive. Matrix inversion gives A=(1+t-ix)/((1-ix)(1+t-ix)+s²), L=Re A. Differentiation gives L’=s²(Fminus Fplus)/(p²+q²)² with F± affine in t. Analyzing their intercepts and slopes yields each monotone/unique interior extremum region, including x=1 flat only at s²=2. There A=1/2+it/[2(t+2)] and elastic |A|² and inelastic Re A−|A|² trade at equal opposite derivatives. Independent symbolic SymPy verified response and derivative factorization and flat point identity; this does not replace all-parameter factor-sign proof.
